==Description==
The '''Monopoly Roblox 2022 Edition''' is a Roblox-themed board game released on the 1st of August 2021, made by Hasbro. It is a ''Monopoly'' board game where properties are replaced with Roblox games, with one of them being ''Tower Defense Simulator''. When you buy the board game, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the {{RLinkC|6443423649|Mr. Bling Bling Hat}} accessory on Roblox. The toy is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:MONOPOLY GAME WITH ROBLOX THEME: The imaginative worlds of Roblox meet the Monopoly board game! In this edition, players get to buy, sell, and trade some of their favorite Roblox experiences  
*'''On Pack'''
*:Buy, sell and trade your favorite Roblox games.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $19.99 in the US, CA$28.45 in Canada, £17.88 in the UK and €20.91 in the EU.

The following list is a selection of the online stores that you can buy this item from. This is not meant to be a comprehensible list:
*[https://www.amazon.com/Hasbro-Gaming-F1325-Monopoly-Roblox/dp/B08BHQMY4J Amazon] (Worldwide)
*[https://hasbropulse.com/products/monopoly-roblox Hasbro Pulse] (Worldwide)

==Trivia==
*While ''Tower Defense Simulator'' is included in this board game as a property, it is the cheapest property out of all other games included.
**''Tower Defense Simulator'' replaces ''Old Kent Road'' on the standard UK edition of ''Monopoly'' and ''Mediterranean Avenue'' on the standard US edition of ''Monopoly''.
